recommendation: Race’s pick (15 Nov 2026): Night, with a fifth level added to the meter. Bright blue output, full, beside violet input at three of five on a black tile; the best of the five at 16 px.

bold.idea: Today’s Peaks with nothing extra and everything bigger: four chunky flat segments a side instead of six thin glassy ones, unlit segments simply dimmed, filling 60% of the tile.
bold.verdict: The closest to today’s icon, done better: calm and confident, and it sits well next to Tailscale. The cost: with no second colour it can read a little like a list icon, and output and input differ only by how full they are.

night.idea: Peaks on a black tile: five flat segments a side in bright blue output (full) beside violet input (three of five), unlit segments as dim tints, as Tailscale shows its idle dots.
night.verdict: The best at 16 px and the nearest to the Spotify and Tailscale bar: high contrast, and the full-versus-half shape is obvious at every size. The cost: it gives up Peaks’ blue tile, so it feels like a cousin of today’s icon rather than the same one.

blend.idea: The colour moves to the tile: one sweep from output blue to input violet, with a plain white four-segment meter on top, as Claude puts one white glyph on one vivid tile.
blend.verdict: The friendliest and most current-looking: one white glyph, one colour sweep, nothing else. The cost: the blue-to-violet tile is a new note in your family of deep tiles, and pill ends make it read a touch more like a list.

daylight.idea: Today’s meter redrawn large and flat on a white tile: four fat pills a side, blue output full beside violet input lit three of four, in the spirit of Time Machine.
daylight.verdict: The one truly different take: crisp and friendly. The costs: it leaves Peaks’ dark blue look furthest behind, it glares as a white square in a dark Dock, and it is the softest of the five at 16 px.

duo.idea: Peaks on today’s deep navy, cut to three wide segments a side in output blue (full) and input violet (two of three), the fewest and biggest segments of the five.
duo.verdict: Keeps today’s navy and adds the blue/violet story with the biggest shapes. The cost: blue on navy is lower in contrast than Night, so it is murkier at 16 px; it is the gentler sibling of Night.
